snippet.title: Luigi's Lost Memories - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
It's finally here! I truly hope you enjoy the game!

Luigi's Lost Memories is the result of a revamp to a previous project known as 'Luigi's Fight for the Lost Island.' It includes all of the completed content for that game before its cancellation and is reworked into its own story and progression system that ties back into the original game's plot. Because of this, some things, like the world map, have lost their purpose and utility, but are still included as a method of preservation. In addition, quite a bit of extra content was added on top of everything, such as achievements, extra challenges within levels, optional secret exits, and more!

I have provided two download options depending on your situation:

Don't have SMBX2 or aren't familiar with it? Download this one! Just unzip, launch the .exe file, and enjoy!
▶ https://drive.proton.me/urls/D171JY4AG0#dOhRum4FQK8d
Familiar with SMBX2? I have included the episode folder by itself in this download here.
▶ https://drive.proton.me/urls/WZWJ8WG1WG#XgzkzspZ6Qp5


The music in this trailer was made by Red&Green and can be found here.
▶ https://youtu.be/FW3qcMda1Q0
